title: Säynätsalo Town Hall
scope: The exterior of Säynätsalo Town Hall, including the red-brick council chamber and low municipal ranges, the original library wing and the raised courtyard with its two approaches.
limitations: Unpublished envelope levels and secondary facade openings are approximate.
Scope includes the original town hall and library exterior at their mapped outlines, and the raised courtyard. Interior spaces and artwork are outside scope.
